policy: No additional Place, shrine, relic, apparition, Saint or media owner. All IDs refer to canonical source files.
This ledger checks data presence, not literary or theological quality. Narratives still require sentence-level editorial review.
The prior 2026-10-21 shrine inventory's hero-media statuses are historical; current cover counts are recomputed from approved-place-media.
An approved site cover is not evidence of an approved principal Marian image, sacred icon, reliquary or relic photograph.
Associated saint names do not establish verified biography, dates or a 1962 calendar observance.
Never infer relic authenticity, apparition recognition or indoor visitor access from photos or associations.
Source and image rights require explicit matching Place/relic IDs and separate source/original/licence/quality gates.
